I can narrow this down if you tell me your **budget** and whether you need it for **school/work, gaming, travel, or creative work**. For now, here are the best online laptop-deal targets I found for U.S. shoppers **as of June 7, 2026**:

## Best current laptop deals to check

| Best for | Deal / model | Why it’s worth considering |
|---|---:|---|
| **Budget Windows laptop** | **Dell 15 Laptop — $349.99** | Solid basic laptop: Intel Core 3-100U, 8GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 15.6" FHD IPS display. Dell lists it down from $519.99. ([dell.com](https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/deals/pc-laptop-deals?msockid=1f3ffbc4df18619e200aed89de9160eb&utm_source=openai)) |
| **Better budget / everyday use** | **Dell 15 Laptop — $649.99** | Better long-term choice than very cheap models: Core i7-1355U, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD, 15.6" FHD IPS. Dell lists it down from $969.99. ([dell.com](https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/deals/pc-laptop-deals?msockid=1f3ffbc4df18619e200aed89de9160eb&utm_source=openai)) |
| **Cheap Best Buy option** | **Acer Aspire Lite 15 — $279.99** | Very low price for a basic 15.6" FHD laptop; Best Buy lists $220 savings. Best for web, email, docs—not heavy multitasking. ([bestbuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/searchpage.jsp?browsedCategory=pcmcat138500050001&qp=currentoffers_facet%3DCurrent+Deals~On+Sale&utm_source=openai)) |
| **Best Buy Copilot+ value** | **Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3x — about $499.99–$549.99** | 15.3" 2K touchscreen, Snapdragon X, 16GB RAM. Good if you want battery life and light productivity, but check app compatibility for Windows on Arm. ([bestbuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/searchpage.jsp?id=pcat17071&st=laptops+deals&utm_source=openai)) |
| **OLED ultraportable** | **ASUS Zenbook A14 — $749.99** | Best Buy lists this as an “Ultimate Deal”; 14" OLED, Snapdragon X Plus, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD. Good for travel and battery life. ([bestbuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/searchpage.jsp?id=pcat17071&st=laptops+deals&utm_source=openai)) |
| **Gaming** | **Alienware 16 Aurora RTX 5060 — $1,099.99 at Dell** | GamesRadar reports Dell has it $400 off; good midrange gaming pick if you want a current GPU. ([gamesradar.com](https://www.gamesradar.com/cheap-gaming-laptop-deals-190221/?utm_source=openai)) |

## My quick picks

- **Best cheap buy:** Dell 15 at **$349.99** — better storage than many sub-$300 laptops.  
- **Best value for most people:** Dell 15 with **16GB RAM / 1TB SSD at $649.99**.  
- **Best ultra-portable / battery-focused deal:** ASUS Zenbook A14 at **$749.99**.  
- **Best gaming deal:** Alienware 16 Aurora RTX 5060 at **$1,099.99**.  
- **Best “wait a bit” strategy:** If you can wait, **Amazon Prime Day runs June 23–26, 2026**, and Walmart Deals starts June 22, so laptop prices may improve later this month. ([aboutamazon.com](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-day-2026-date?utm_source=openai))

## Buying advice

Avoid laptops with **4GB RAM** or only **128GB storage** unless you need the absolute cheapest web-browsing machine. For most people in 2026, I’d aim for:

- **16GB RAM**
- **512GB SSD or larger**
- **1080p/FHD or better display**
- **Ryzen 5 / Core i5 / Core Ultra 5 / Snapdragon X or better**

If you give me your **max budget** and main use, I’ll pick the top 3 deals for you.
